newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Unilever opens Shanghai research centre.
newsitem.headline: Unilever opens Shanghai research centre.

text.p: Anglo-Dutch food and household products group Unilever said on Monday it had opened a scientific research centre in Shanghai.
"The centre will look at converting understanding of local consumer preferences into Unilever's brands with the help of science," the company said in a statement.
The centre is based at the Shanghai Institute of Organic Chemistry and represented an important link with the Chinese scientific community, the statement said.
Unilever operates 12 joint ventures in China, booking annual turnover in China and Hong Kong of some 500 million dollars.
